    Functors out of a one-point extension, and out of an additive envelope #

    A functor out of the one-point extension of 𝒜 by Ψ is given by a functor F on 𝒜, an object X, scalars k → End X, and maps Ψ(a) → Hom(X, F a) natural in a.

    matLift is Mat_.lift for target categories in arbitrary universes.

    source
    structure ExtriangulatedRealization.OnePointExtension.LiftData {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {𝒜 : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, u₁} 𝒜] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒜] (Ψ : CategoryTheory.Functor 𝒜 (ModuleCat k)) (𝒯 : Type u₂) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₂, u₂} 𝒯] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒯] :
    Type (max (max (max u u₁) u₂) v₂)

    The data of a functor out of the one-point extension.

    • FB : CategoryTheory.Functor 𝒜 𝒯

      The functor on 𝒜.

    • additive : self.FB.Additive
    • Xt : 𝒯

      The image of the adjoined object.

    • sc : k → (self.Xt ⟶ self.Xt)

      The action of scalars on the adjoined object.

    • ι (a : 𝒜) : ↑(Ψ.obj a) → (self.Xt ⟶ self.FB.obj a)

      The morphisms out of the adjoined object.

    • sc_one : self.sc 1 = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id self.Xt
    • sc_mul (c c' : k) : self.sc (c * c') = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.sc c) (self.sc c')
    • sc_add (c c' : k) : self.sc (c + c') = self.sc c + self.sc c'
    • ι_add (a : 𝒜) (x y : ↑(Ψ.obj a)) : self.ι a (x + y) = self.ι a x + self.ι a y
    • ι_nat {a b : 𝒜} (g : a ⟶ b) (x : ↑(Ψ.obj a)) : self.ι b ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom (Ψ.map g)) x) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.ι a x) (self.FB.map g)
    • ι_sc (c : k) (a : 𝒜) (x : ↑(Ψ.obj a)) : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.sc c) (self.ι a x) = self.ι a (c • x)
